deck_title: Enterprise LED-Volume Virtual Production (ICVFX, 255th Demo Milestone!): Tracked Off-Axis Inner-Frustum 3DGS/UE5 + Outer 360° AIGC HDRI Dome + PTP Genlock (c_icvfx = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Static 2D LED / Green-Screen Spill

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise LED-Volume Virtual Production (ICVFX) pipeline evaluation (driving an off-axis Inner-Frustum 3DGS/UE5 render from 6DoF optical camera tracking, illuminating reflective subjects via an Outer-Frustum 360-degree AIGC 16-bit HDRI dome, and locking camera shutter phase via PTPv2/Genlock so amortized unit cost c_icvfx(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_icvfx = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive untracked 2D video playback on LED walls or green-screen shooting (which causes flat-poster parallax collapse, rolling-shutter scanline bars, and green spill on hair/car paint, inflating post-production rotoscoping cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-ray frustum quadrature.
